issues.description: The problem statement and tests require public getters for each attribute (e.g., getLectureName(), getNumberOfInscribedStudents()), but the solution implementation declares some of these getters as private (getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents()). This visibility mismatch will cause confusion and test failures because students and tests expect these accessor methods to be public.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the visibility of the attribute getter methods to public in the implementation so they match the problem description and expected tests. Specifically, make getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() public (and ensure all other getters are public as well). Update the solution (and template examples if present) so getter method signatures are public.
